data.long_meaning: In Greek, the name Alesandrini is derived from 'Alexandros', meaning 'defender of mankind'. This name has been popular in Christian tradition due to Saint Alexander the Great, a renowned military leader and Christian convert. The name Alesandrini carries the meaning “Defender of mankind” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alesandrini usually hope their child will grow to embody defender of mankind and live with faith, good character and purpose.
